2. Icy accents, such as snow and glaciers, will further emphasize the cold climate and create visual interest.

4. Set the valley depth to 50 units, which will create a deep, dramatic valley.
5. Add snow and glaciers as features, which will incorporate icy accents and highlight the cold climate.

These actions will help to achieve the geological goals of creating a dramatic alpine valley with jagged cliffs and icy accents.
